items.name: Cardiology
items.summary: Diagnosis and treatment of heart and vascular conditions, from prevention to advanced cardiac care.
items.description: Our cardiology team combines non-invasive diagnostics with evidence-based treatment plans. We manage hypertension, coronary artery disease, arrhythmias and heart failure, and run a dedicated cardiac rehabilitation programme to get patients back to everyday life safely.

items.name: Dental Care
items.summary: General, cosmetic and orthodontic dentistry for the whole family in a calm, modern setting.
items.description: From routine check-ups and hygiene to implants, clear aligners and smile design, our dental clinic uses digital X-rays and intra-oral scanning for precise, comfortable treatment.

items.name: Pediatrics
items.summary: Gentle, expert care for newborns, children and teenagers, including vaccinations and growth monitoring.
items.description: Our child-friendly clinic follows the national vaccination schedule and offers well-baby visits, developmental assessments, allergy and asthma care, and same-day appointments for sick children.

items.name: Orthopedics
items.summary: Bone, joint and sports-injury care, from physiotherapy to joint replacement.
items.description: We treat back and neck pain, fractures, arthritis and sports injuries with a step-by-step approach that starts with conservative care and physiotherapy and moves to minimally invasive surgery only when needed.

items.name: Dermatology
items.summary: Medical and aesthetic skin, hair and nail treatments by board-certified dermatologists.
items.description: We diagnose and treat acne, eczema, psoriasis, pigmentation and hair loss, and offer evidence-based aesthetic procedures including laser therapy and skin-rejuvenation treatments.

items.name: Obstetrics & Gynecology
items.summary: Women's health at every stage: pregnancy care, fertility advice and gynecological treatment.
items.description: Our all-female obstetrics and gynecology team provides antenatal care with 4D ultrasound, family-planning advice, menopause care and minimally invasive gynecological surgery.

items.name: Internal Medicine
items.summary: Comprehensive adult care for diabetes, thyroid, digestive and chronic conditions.
items.description: Internists coordinate your overall health: annual check-ups, chronic disease management, and referrals to the right specialist. Our diabetes education programme is run with certified diabetes educators and dietitians.

items.name: Ophthalmology
items.summary: Eye exams, cataract and LASIK assessment, and care for glaucoma and diabetic eye disease.
items.description: Using OCT imaging and computerised visual-field testing, our ophthalmologists detect eye disease early and provide treatment from glasses prescriptions to cataract surgery.
